name: Jellyfin Ignore Per-Library
description: Community fork of Jellyfin Ignore with per-library globs and automatic Windows aliases that keep nested dedicated libraries scannable without moving or copying media.
overview: Per-library ignore globs with automatic nested-root isolation

versions.changelog: Replace unreliable scan-context inference with automatic NTFS junction aliases, cache resolver state outside ShouldIgnore, and add fail-safe validation and status reporting.
